name: Gremolata
ingredients: ½ cup parsley (washed, dried, and finely chopped)
½ tsp sea salt or maldon salt
⅓ cup good quality extra virgin olive oil (optional)
steps: Combine ingredients in a bowl and stir. Season to taste with more salt.
